description: The aesthetic gained mainstream popularity in the early 2020s, largely driven by the success of the Netflix series Bridgerton . This led to a surge of interest in what became known as " Regencycore ," a sub-style that is often used interchangeably with Royalcore. [ 2 ] The aesthetic is a form of escapism, allowing participants to adopt a more glamorous, luxurious, and extravagant identity than that of modern daily life. [ 3 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Elegance, romance, opulence, sophistication, escapism, femininity
